evidence_role: Fresh paired development/convenience replay of previously observed task-owned validation logs; not recovered historical inputs, held-out confirmation, independent tasks, or provider billing.

selection.frame: The nine complete task-owned logs explicitly named with exit receipts by the integration owner before replay; this is a bounded declared frame, not all machine logs.
selection.rule: Retain every named complete log irrespective of outcome, size, token savings or marker retention; deduplicate only identical raw bytes plus exit and record any duplicates. Never execute archived commands.

interrupted_run_exclusion.reason: Installer canceled before completion; exit 130 is not a completed validation result; no complete source log admitted.

baseline.method: Validated immutable historical source stage, with the same input bytes, exit and artifact path as the candidate.

routing.rule: Use archived size only as a simulated prior observation; retain each below-margin case and block expansion of efficacy claims without changing thresholds.

capture.meaning: Reconstructed deterministic merged-byte stream; original stdout/stderr chunk boundaries are unavailable. Chunk invariance is tested separately; no original process is re-executed.

annotation.rule: Exact source lines whose SGR-stripped text starts with (fail), FAIL/FAILED, error:, or AssertionError:, case-insensitively. Enumerate before reducer invocation; preserve every marker outcome.
annotation.meaning: Syntactic reporter markers only, including possible expected-error output; not actionable diagnosis, semantic completeness, or human review. Retention means the exact raw line appears in the presented text.
annotation.sensitivity: Charge one full original-log retrieval when any marker is absent; this is a counterfactual lower-bound accounting scenario excluding lookup invocation/reasoning, not an observed read.
annotation.occurrence_limit: Exact line-presence matching can credit repeated identical source lines through one retained occurrence; counts do not certify per-occurrence locations, relationships, diagnosis or repair.

public_output: Only opaque identifiers, hashes, scalar metadata, invariant outcomes and token/marker counts. Raw bytes, original commands, private paths and presented strings remain outside the repository.
decision_rule: Every paired invariant must pass; full-capture valid-UTF8 output remains equal; controlled early diagnostics and final tail remain visible as declared. Publish all real marker gains/losses and net-margin failures; synthetic byte savings are not efficacy evidence. No task-success, speedup, billed-cost or broad diagnostic-completeness claim.
